channel.title: Breakage Radar: Home Assistant API removals
channel.description: Home Assistant APIs scheduled for removal, and how many HACS custom integrations still use each one.

item.title: Home Assistant 2027.8 - 4 August 2027
item.description:
Home Assistant 2027.8 removes 12 APIs. 642 HACS custom integrations in the catalogue still use them.

What is being removed

  • async_device_info_to_link_from_device_id: calls async_device_info_to_link_from_device_id, which is deprecated and always returns None: a device_info carrying another device's identifiers implicitly added the caller's config entry to that device, which a single-config-entry device can't represent. Set entity.device_entry to the target device instead. Used by 2 integrations. source
  • async_device_info_to_link_from_entity: calls async_device_info_to_link_from_entity, which is deprecated and always returns None: a device_info carrying another device's identifiers implicitly added the caller's config entry to that device, which a single-config-entry device can't represent. Set entity.device_entry = async_entity_id_to_device(hass, source_entity_id) instead. Used by 2 integrations. source
  • async_handle_source_entity_changes(add_helper_config_entry_to_device=…: calls async_handle_source_entity_changes with add_helper_config_entry_to_device, which no longer has any effect. Used by 1 integration. source
  • async_remove_helper_config_entry_from_source_device: homeassistant.helpers.helper_integration.async_remove_helper_devices. Used by 8 integrations. source
  • async_remove_stale_devices_links_keep_current_device: calls async_remove_stale_devices_links_keep_current_device, which is deprecated and does nothing: a device belongs to a single config entry, so a helper no longer adds its config entry to another device. Call homeassistant.helpers.helper_integration.async_remove_helper_devices with remove_all_devices=True instead. Used by 3 integrations. source
  • async_remove_stale_devices_links_keep_entity_device: calls async_remove_stale_devices_links_keep_entity_device, which is deprecated and does nothing: a device belongs to a single config entry, so a helper no longer adds its config entry to the source device. Call homeassistant.helpers.helper_integration.async_remove_helper_devices with remove_all_devices=True instead. Used by 2 integrations. source
  • DeviceEntry.config_entries: DeviceEntry.config_entries is deprecated -- 'Deprecated, use DeviceEntry.config_entry_id instead.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8. Detected only where the receiver is proven to be a DeviceEntry (a registry lookup, a DeviceEntry annotation, or the async_remove_config_entry_device contract); hass.config_entries is never flagged. Used by 196 integrations. source
  • DeviceEntry.primary_config_entry: DeviceEntry.primary_config_entry is deprecated and removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8 -- 'Deprecated, use DeviceEntry.config_entry_id instead.' Devices are now restricted to a single config entry. Used by 17 integrations. source
  • via_device: DeviceInfo['via_device'] and DeviceRegistry.async_get_or_create(via_device=...) are deprecated -- 'Deprecated, use via_device_id instead.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8. Used by 223 integrations. source
  • DeviceRegistry.async_get_device: DeviceRegistry.async_get_device() is deprecated -- 'Identifiers and connections are only unique per config entry.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8; use async_get_device_by_identifier() or async_get_device_by_connection(). Used by 340 integrations. source
  • config_entries (device registry WebSocket field): Reads the config_entries field of a device registry WebSocket result. 'Old fields: config_entries, config_entries_subentries, and primary_config_entry. Replacements: config_entry_id and config_subentry_id. Removal: Home Assistant Core 2027.8.' Until then the old field is derived from the new one, so nothing is broken today. Used by 5 integrations. source
  • DeviceRegistry.async_update_device(add_config_entry_id=...): 'The add_config_entry_id, add_config_subentry_id, remove_config_entry_id and remove_config_subentry_id parameters are all deprecated.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8; use new_config_entry_id / new_config_subentry_id. Used by 74 integrations. source

item.title: Home Assistant 2026.10 - 7 October 2026
item.description:
Home Assistant 2026.10 removes 5 APIs. 11 HACS custom integrations in the catalogue still use them.

What is being removed

  • async_extract_config_entry_ids: passes hass to async_extract_config_entry_ids, where the leading hass argument is ignored and is removed in Home Assistant 2026.10. Drop the argument from the call. Used by 4 integrations. source
  • async_extract_entities: passes hass to async_extract_entities, where the leading hass argument is ignored and is removed in Home Assistant 2026.10. Drop the argument from the call. Used by 1 integration. source
  • async_extract_entity_ids: passes hass to async_extract_entity_ids, where the leading hass argument is ignored and is removed in Home Assistant 2026.10. Drop the argument from the call. Used by 4 integrations. source
  • extract_entity_ids: passes hass to extract_entity_ids, where the leading hass argument is ignored and is removed in Home Assistant 2026.10. Drop the argument from the call. Used by 1 integration. source
  • verify_domain_control: passes hass to verify_domain_control, where the leading hass argument is ignored and is removed in Home Assistant 2026.10. Drop the argument from the call. Used by 2 integrations. source

item.title: Home Assistant 2026.11 - 4 November 2026
item.description:
Home Assistant 2026.11 removes 4 APIs. 89 HACS custom integrations in the catalogue still use them.

What is being removed

  • async_add_external_statistics(missing unit_class): doesn't specify unit_class when calling async_add_external_statistics. Used by 66 integrations. source
  • async_import_statistics(missing mean_type): doesn't specify mean_type when calling async_import_statistics. Used by 26 integrations. source
  • async_import_statistics(missing unit_class): doesn't specify unit_class when calling async_import_statistics. Used by 26 integrations. source
  • async_update_statistics_metadata(missing unit_class): doesn't specify unit_class when calling async_update_statistics_metadata. Used by 2 integrations. source

item.title: Home Assistant 2027.5 - 5 May 2027
item.description:
Home Assistant 2027.5 removes 2 APIs. 12 HACS custom integrations in the catalogue still use them.

What is being removed

  • setup_scanner: Implements the legacy (non-config-entry) device tracker platform API. 'The legacy (non-config-entry) device tracker platform API is deprecated and will be removed in the Home Assistant 2027.5 release.' Migrate to the modern device tracker platform API (config entry + ScannerEntity/TrackerEntity). Used by 12 integrations. source
  • DeviceScanner: Subclasses homeassistant.components.device_tracker.DeviceScanner, part of the legacy device tracker platform API removed in Home Assistant 2027.5. Migrate to ScannerEntity on a config entry. Used by 6 integrations. source

item.title: Home Assistant 2027.7 - 7 July 2027
item.description:
Home Assistant 2027.7 removes 3 APIs. 30 HACS custom integrations in the catalogue still use them.

What is being removed

  • get_astral_location: homeassistant.helpers.sun.get_astral_observer. Used by 3 integrations. source
  • battery_level: 'The battery_level property has been deprecated in all device tracker base classes, and will stop working in Home Assistant Core 2027.7.' Expose the battery as a separate sensor entity with device_class battery instead. Used by 19 integrations. source
  • location_name: 'The location_name property of TrackerEntity has been deprecated, and will stop working in Home Assistant Core 2027.7.' Set the entity state from latitude/longitude and let Home Assistant resolve the zone. Used by 13 integrations. source
